messages.subject: Pre-release version of aroma.affymetrix v2
parts:
Dear Henrik,

As I mentioned in another post ("How to reload CBS/GLAD segmentation
result files (.xdr) and generate output by ChromosomeExplorer"), we
are currently trying to analyze over 3000 Affy 500k samples.
Apparently, it is impossible for us to process all the samples at the
same time. We plan to divide them into smaller groups and analyze them
separately, which means we really need those single-array pre-
processing methods implemented in aroma.affymetrix v2. Since
aroma.affymetrix v2 has not been released, could you provide us your
pre-release or test version so that we can begin our analysis?

Thanks!

Harry
